test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which city hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Beijing.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct option for the question is option 3, Beijing.**
 
• The 2022 Winter Olympics will be held in Beijing, China from **February 4 to February 20, 2022.**
 
• ** Beijing will become the first city to host both the Summer and Winter Olympics,** having hosted the Summer Olympics in 2008.
 
• This event is scheduled to take place from 4 to 20 February 2022.
 
• This Olympics began in the year 1896.
 
• Since then 28 Summer Olympics have been held in 23 cities and 23 winter Olympics conducted in 20 cities.
 
• Also, three summer and two winter Olympics had to be cancelled or rescheduled due to war.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Milan is incorrect as Milan was the host city for the 2026 Winter Olympics.
 
• Tokyo is incorrect as Tokyo hosted the 2020 Summer Olympics, which were postponed to 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• Melbourne is incorrect as Melbourne has never hosted the Winter Olympics. It did host the 1956 Summer Olympics.
